current.changeLog:
1.Removed the need to press ALT!
2.New Settings per Tag/Icon:
-Custom Icons can be added by the players. 
-Players can now change the Tag Labels/Names.
3.Extended "Blacklist". 
4.Fixed a defect where in garage you could not clean a player tag.
5.Minor improvements

previous.changeLog: Fixed opening Exterior Studio and switching seasons; added translations for Camo Selector's style-owned item filters.

current.changeLog: Added an Emissions category for Camo Selector custom assets with animated previews and click-to-apply placement; apply emissions to the whole vehicle or copy them to all seasons; remove emissions from a selected part or clear the entire vehicle across all seasons; gun and mantlet share one emission assignment.

previous.changeLog: Fixed custom camouflage and decal textures requiring a restart after first use in a new game folder.

current.changeLog: Added custom colour-cycling paints and static, pulsing or colour-cycling emissions with colour pickers, adjustable timing and animated previews; create emissions in Camo Selector and apply them through Exterior Studio; choose the animation type when creating an asset; these custom effects remain local and are excluded from Style Share.

previous.changeLog: - Added preliminary map for Nebelburg. (The changes on existing maps are being reviewed atm.)

current.changeLog: - Updated maps for Himmelsdorf and Ruinberg.

Added battle music for the safe haven map
Added Ready for Action battle loading music for the widepark map
Added Full Mod + All Garage Music
